mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_DESC, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.QUANTITY, P.SELLER_NO, S.STORE_NAME, S.CEO_NAME, S.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, S.BUSINESS_DETAIL_ADDRESS, S.EMAIL, S.PHONE, S.MAIL_ORDER_NO, S.BUSINESS_NO, P.SALE_STATUS, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NO, SC.CATEGORY_NAME AS SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, MC.CATEGORY_NO AS MID_CATEGORY_NO, MC.CATEGORY_NAME AS MID_CATEGORY_NAME, MAINC.CATEGORY_NO AS MAIN_CATEGORY_NO, MAINC.CATEGORY_NAME AS MAIN_CATEGORY_NAME FROM PRODUCT P JOIN SELLER S ON P.SELLER_NO = S.SELLER_NO JOIN CATEGORY SC ON P.SUB_CATEGORY_NO = SC.CATEGORY_NO JOIN CATEGORY MC ON SC.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO = MC.CATEGORY_NO JOIN CATEGORY MAINC ON MC.PARENT_CATEGORY_NO = MAINC.CATEGORY_NO WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.SALE_STATUS != '승인 대기' AND P.DISPLAY_YN = 'Y'
SELECT OPTION_ID FROM PRODUCT_OPTION WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY OPTION_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
